change_reason: Astra041 preflight requested path-specific likely-delay handling and explicit entry state with backedge, before graph implementation. This source supplement does not implement a graph engine.
contract_clarifications: A raw control row may retain a physical unsupported delay_error even when a statically false likely branch annuls that instruction on every feasible path. Graph incompleteness belongs only to paths that actually execute the delay.

Unknown likely condition preserves useful false-path consumer facts while separately retaining taken-path unsupported-delay incompleteness. Always-taken likely condition cannot establish the false-path consumer.

Explicit entry boundary facts coexist with ordinary local predecessor edges. Reaching definitions before an entry read include external incoming value plus any local loop-carried definitions, even when entry indegree is nonzero.

Conservative explicit operand reads include same-register branch site itself. Thus false BNEL t0,t0 gives uses afterLUI={0x100004,0x10000c}, complete because kill0x100010 closes value flow; no predicate-independence optimization added.

concrete_cases.annulled: LUI+0; BNEL t0,t0+4; unsupported+8; consumer+12; kill+16; JR+20; NOP+24. uses={+4,+12}, defs beforeconsumer={+0}, complete under explicit entry.
concrete_cases.taken: BEQL t0,t0 variant: uses={+4}, incomplete unsupported_delay_word. Consumer+12 not established.
concrete_cases.unknown: BNEL t0,t1 variant: known uses={+4,+12}, incomplete unsupported_delay_word on taken outcome only.
concrete_cases.backedge: Entry+0 ADDIU a0,t0,0; +4 LUI t0; +8 J base; +12 NOP. defs BEFOREentry={def+4,entry+0}; uses AFTERLUI={+0}, locally complete.

replay: freeze.py extracts and executes the exact original-helper harness AST from sealed initial freeze.py with new literal contexts/query tuples. It bypasses original constructors/imports/main. Original helper outputs retain their flaws separately; e.g backedge original returns onlydef+4, missing entryfact; taken BEQL original wrongly reports consumer+12.
primary_evidence: Initial pinned primary/Interpreter.cpp411-436 implements BEQL/BNEL with false outcome skipping delay. Original Code.reaching_defs517-536 derives entry solely from absent predecessors, motivating backedge counterexample.
limitations: Low32 normal-completion conservative facts under explicit synthetic entries. No whole-program scope proof, graph Go/API implementation, call policy extension, .05/.06 award, approval, patch or code reduction. No protected resource access.
